name: recover-pilot
note: Frozen pilot: 2 targets x 3 difficulties x 3 reps = 18 runs. Prompts are deliberately NEUTRAL about the obfuscation technique (we are measuring what Qwen chooses, not steering it). Do not edit prompts/model/reps between runs of the same campaign; bump 'version' and start a new dataset instead.
